Build a set of VPUs, then merge them

Source: R/run_vpus.R
run_vpus.Rd

A loop over run_pipeline() with per-VPU inputs, so a national build is a list of paths rather than a script. One VPU failing does not stop the rest by default; the return value says which succeeded, and merge_vpus() can be run from it once they all have.

inputs is a named list, one entry per vpuid, each holding the arguments that differ for that VPU. Anything passed in ... applies to every VPU, so shared paths are given once.

Usage

run_vpus(
  inputs,
  out_dir,
  ...,
  continue_on_error = TRUE,
  merge = FALSE,
  merge_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

inputs

Named list of per-VPU argument lists, keyed by vpuid.

out_dir

Parent output directory; each VPU writes vpu_{vpuid}/.

...

Arguments common to every VPU, forwarded to run_pipeline().

continue_on_error

If TRUE (default), record a failure and carry on. FALSE stops at the first one.

merge

If TRUE, merge the VPUs that succeeded once the loop finishes. Default FALSE.

merge_dir

Directory for the merged domain products when merge = TRUE. Defaults to file.path(out_dir, "global").

Value

A data frame with one row per VPU: vpuid, status ("ok"/"error"/"invariant"/"skipped"), ngen_gpkg, minutes, and message. "invariant" means the build finished but its gates went red; it counts as a failure and blocks the merge, because a product that does not pass its own suite is not one to publish. Returned invisibly when every VPU succeeded.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conus <- c("01","02","03N","03S","03W","04","05","06","07","08","09",
           "10L","10U","11","12","13","14","15","16","17","18")

# Shared inputs once, per-VPU overrides where they differ.
inputs <- stats::setNames(vector("list", length(conus)), conus)
inputs[["20"]] <- list(reference_gpkg = "hi_reference.gpkg",
                       fdr_path = "hi/hi_fdr.vrt", fac_path = "hi/hi_fac.vrt")

res <- run_vpus(
  inputs,
  out_dir        = "out",
  reference_gpkg = "conus_reference.gpkg",
  fdr_path       = "conus/fdr.vrt",
  fac_path       = "conus/fac.vrt",
  skip_if_exists = TRUE,
  merge          = TRUE)

subset(res, status != "ok")
} # }
